content: Anita Sharma from Trust Wealth Advisors calls customer Anvi Desai to discuss health policy renewal. Anvi inquires about specialist-visit coverage and pre-authorization requirements (which apply unless it's an emergency or a direct primary doctor referral, with a 24-48 hour turnaround). Anita explains the renewal deadline of 15 October 2026 for retroactive activation to 1 October 2026, and the submission methods (e-sign and email or fax). Anvi confirms she will e-sign and email the renewal form right after the call.

action_items: Customer to e-sign and email the renewal form
Agent to update the system and send confirmation email upon receiving the signed form
